messages:
lisa-sales: Heads-up — BigBank asks for a POC: control plane pinned to EU, inference nodes on their on-prem Canada cluster, BYO-KMS, and strict no-egress for request payloads. They also want a pricing delta and an operations checklist. Who can confirm feasibility?

alex-eng: short answer: doable with Redwood Private + a customer-managed onprem deployment. A few caveats: model weights and any optional telemetry need explicit placement. If they want weights never to leave their network, we treat it as an on-prem-only serving package (airgap-ish).

maria-privacy: @lisa-sales thanks — we need the full sub-processor list + which control-plane telemetry fields are enabled. Also: confirm whether customer requires HSM-backed keys (HSM vs cloud KMS) for BYOK. If HSM, that's additional procurement and paperwork.

jon-sre: network notes: inbound control-plane signaling can be restricted to EU control plane endpoints, but data plane (inference) is entirely on-prem in CA. For failover we can configure a regional standby (eu-west1) but need customer's approval for cross-border fallback. Example routing config we propose:

```yaml
routing_policy:
  primary_region: ca-central1
  control_plane: eu-west1
  fallback_regions:
    - eu-west1
    - us-east1  # only if customer allows cross-border failover
  egress: restrict_to_customer_cidr: true
```

jon-sre: also, certs: we'll need mutual TLS between control plane and onprem agents, and a short-lived service cert rotation plan. Ops impact: ~2-3 engineer days to wire cert rotation + monitoring hooks.

lisa-sales: pricing ask — can we get a ballpark delta vs hosted? Also, they'll want a one-time packaging fee for on-prem artifacts and an ops-onboarding charge.

alex-eng: ballpark numbers (very rough):
- Private deployment reserve: +$6k/mo
- On-prem packaging / airgap support: one-time +$30k
- BYO-KMS integration + HSM certification (if required): one-time +$12k
- Ops monitoring & SRE handoff (setup): one-time +$5k
Total first month uplift: ~+$53k one-time, recurring +$6k/mo. If no HSM and lightweight BYOK: drop ~$10k from one-time.

sam-account: tagging finance — we'll need to convert that into an SOW line item. Also check tax/regulatory impacts for Canada-hosted inference.

maria-privacy: security questionnaire notes: we can provide the sub-processor matrix but need 72 hrs to pull the detailed KMS control flows and data-at-rest diagrams. If BigBank wants an explicit "no telemetry" mode, confirm which metrics they are okay to disable (we can run without telemetry but lose some debugging traces).

lisa-sales: action items: 1) @alex-eng to confirm whether model artifacts can remain fully on-prem for our runtime packaging or whether small metadata must go to EU control plane (due EOD) 2) @maria-privacy to produce sub-processor + KMS flow (72h) 3) @jon-sre provide ops ETA and cert rotation plan (3d) 4) @sam-account to draft SOW numbers for pricing team. I'll loop in customer for a decision call tomorrow. :+1:

deploy-bot: INF-1234 created: "bigbank-poc-onprem-byo-kms" — assignees: alex-eng, jon-sre — due: 3d.

alex-eng: noted. One more technical point — if they need model updates (retraining pushes) we need a secure transfer channel; recommend SFTP+signed manifests or a package signed by their CI. I'll sketch the transfer flow in the ticket.

lisa-sales: perfect. I'll send the short checklist + schedule the call.
